forecast_target: mudslide event time conditional on the identified case source and occurrence within the forecast horizon
criterion: Q2 statistical trigger assessment; conditional time density proportional to assessment intensity
interval_estimand: event time conditional on occurrence within horizon and fixed source
within_bin_time_assumption: uniform density; numerical interpolation, not extra time observations

case_reference_coverage.scope: one competition-reported reference under the adopted event clock, not multi-disaster generalization

single_task_reference_hit.scope: one competition-reported reference under the adopted event clock, not multi-disaster generalization

reference_time_type: competition event clock adopted as trigger-time benchmark; minute-scale source/impact distinctions are simplified
spatial_scope: Q2 static source-to-port DEM corridor, determined before Q4 simulation; not full 2D inundation
forecast_input_source: Q1-selected anomaly trajectories + Q2 actual archived weather water/thermal gate, with unchanged Q2 equation

hazard_base_rate.method: conditional intensity normalization; no invented baseline event count

model_assumptions: fixed case source and available material
one event in the specified horizon when reporting conditional time
time density proportional to Q2 assessment intensity
